rationale: License identification, rights compatibility, entitlement requirements, redistribution eligibility and release admission are deterministic policy/legal governance decisions. Decision Fabric must not rank, relax, override or expand license/right eligibility. Scanner evidence may inform the deterministic policy engine, and REVIEW_REQUIRED cases remain human/legal review rather than AI decision delegation.
not_delegated: model dataset asset or output-rights authorization
